title: James Aris - SEVERED (Feat. Izzy)
htmlContent:
James Aris and Izzy team up for new single "SEVERED," a perfect record to show where high class artistry and mass appeal meet to make one stellar record. The sound is able to capture a nice commercial touch that makes it ready for the world, while still having an underlying touch to the music that lets you feel it all on a high level, to make for a true experience that you can come to for time to come.
